text:
Oncall Bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: 3xx/5xx error-rate for /v1/generate (hosted) exceeded 6% in eu-west-1 over the last 5m. SLO risk threshold breached. Paging primary on-call. Incident ID: INC-20260314-42

Alex Chen: Taking this. I'm primary until 12:00 UTC. Starting initial triage.

Priya Nair: I'm secondary and available for escalation. quick ask — is this region-only or global?

Alex Chen: Looks region-limited to eu-west-1 based on traces. Top span shows timeouts hitting model-serving layer.

Matt Rodriguez: I'm looking at infra metrics, GPU pool for dedicated nodes in eu-west is spiky, pods OOMing after the recent quantized model rollout.

Alex Chen: Good catch. Linking runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/model-serving/timeout-and-ooms (follow steps 1-4). I'm going to scale the pool + put a temporary routing fallback to smaller model.

Priya Nair: FYI Ops dashboard: `infractl scale pool --region eu-west-1 --pool model-dedicated --replicas +3` and `routingctl set-fallback --route gen --model rwl-v1-small` will reduce latency but may slightly change quality.

Alex Chen: Running `infractl` now. Pasting logs: ```
> infractl scale pool --region eu-west-1 --pool model-dedicated --replicas +3
Scaling initiated, expected convergence ~3m
> routingctl set-fallback --route gen --model rwl-v1-small --duration 30m
Fallback active
```

Oncall Bot: :white_check_mark: Fallback engaged, incident state set to "mitigating". PagerDuty: acknowledged by Alex Chen.

Priya Nair: Given this is a known noisy period during the deploy window, I recommend temporarily raising the SLO alert threshold for the alert `gen.error-rate-eu-west-5m` from 5% -> 10% for 30m to avoid paging the team for mitigated noise. Anyone object?

Matt Rodriguez: +1 for temporary threshold increase. We should annotate it in the incident and revert automatically.

Alex Chen: Agree. I'll apply the threshold change and add a label so the alert will auto-revert after 30m. Command: `alertsctl patch gen.error-rate-eu-west-5m --threshold 10 --expires 30m --comment "fallout during rwl-v2 rollout, fallback active"`

Alex Chen: Applied. `alertsctl` response: "patched, will expire at 2026-03-14T12:30:21Z"

Priya Nair: Noted customer impact: early estimates show ~0.8% of total requests in eu-west got 5xxs that impacted interactive sessions; a handful of paying customers reported degraded response times. Logged to incident.

Alex Chen: Starting post-mitigation checks: 1) error-rate trending down, 2) fallback holding, 3) no elevated tail-latency on other regions.

Deploy Bot: Deploy rwl-v2-model quantized -> eu-west-1 detected at 11:42 UTC. Rollback suggestion flagged.

Matt Rodriguez: We should roll back rwl-v2 for eu-west and run a canary with smaller batch size. I'll coordinate with infra to do a targeted rollback on the affected nodes.

Alex Chen: Rolling back on eu-west pool now. `deployctl rollback rwl-v2 --region eu-west-1 --selector quantized=true`

Oncall Bot: :information_source: Incident updated to "recovering". Customer impact tag: partial. Expected full recovery in ~12m.

Priya Nair: For the handoff at 12:00 UTC, I'll take primary once Alex signs off. Note: there's a coverage gap in the schedule from 03:00-04:00 UTC tomorrow due to daylight swap — needs follow-up.

Alex Chen: Confirming rollback completed and metrics look stable. Error-rate back under 1.2% for 10m. Reverting temporary alert threshold early. `alertsctl revert gen.error-rate-eu-west-5m` -> success.

Alex Chen: Leaving these handoff notes for Priya: 1) Incident ID INC-20260314-42; mitigation: fallback to rwl-v1-small + rollback rwl-v2 in eu-west; 2) customer impact: partial, some degraded interactive sessions, CS alerted; 3) follow-ups: run full rollout audit for quantization config; consider permanent alert tuning if we see recurring noise; 4) runbook pointer: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/model-serving/timeout-and-ooms 5) action item: update calendar to cover the 03:00-04:00 UTC gap or find on-call overlap.

Priya Nair: Thanks, Alex. Taking primary. I'll keep the incident open until 2h stable. Adding task to backlog for alert-rewrite: should change `gen.error-rate-*` to use adaptive thresholds based on deployment-tag and model-size.

Matt Rodriguez: I'll open the rollout postmortem and include kernel/quantization flags. Also adding an ops play to test autoscaling under quantized memory patterns.

Oncall Bot: :white_check_mark: Incident INC-20260314-42 moved to "monitoring". All actions and temporary alert changes logged.

Alex Chen: Quick ack — if anything flares, @Priya Nair is primary. Leaving now. :wave: Good job team.

Priya Nair: :thumbsup: copying notes into the handoff channel now.

Matt Rodriguez: :thumbsup: reopening if we see regression.

Oncall Bot: Reminder scheduled: Handoff checklist — confirm primary/secondary, confirm runbook tasks assigned, confirm alert overrides documented.

Priya Nair: Will follow up on the coverage gap with the rotation manager.

Alex Chen: End of thread.
